rationale.edition: All changed file paths are under web/src/ (plugins/traces/ and locales/). None live in enterprise-owned directories (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/). Although the diff modifies enterprise-gated code paths (isEnterprise checks for correlation), the file paths themselves are OSS — and path-based classification is authoritative per the triage spec.
rationale.skip: No skip: the diff modifies user-facing Vue components (TraceDetailsSidebar.vue, ServiceGraphNodeSidePanel.vue, TraceDetails.vue) that change how 'View Logs' buttons behave — adding async correlation lookups, toast warnings on failure, and fixing log stream URL parameters. No explicit opt-out labels or skip comments present.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted because the change alters real user interaction flows: the 'View Logs' button in the trace details sidebar now awaits a correlation lookup and shows toast warnings when nothing is correlated or the lookup fails; the 'View Related Logs' button in the service graph node panel now sets corrected URL params (stream, type: trace_explorer) and clears the Logs store initialization flag to prevent session state from silently dropping the intended stream/time range/filter. A user exercising these buttons in the browser will see different behavior than before.
rationale.area: All changed Vue components live under web/src/plugins/traces/ — the Traces product area. The existing CI matrix has a Traces shard (ci_matrix.ent.json append: { Traces: ["service-graph.spec.js"] }), making Traces the natural home for this spec.
rationale.group: The playwright_group is Traces — it is an existing shared shard defined in the OSS CI matrix with enterprise-overlay specs appended via ci_matrix.ent.json (append.Traces). The new spec joins that group to run alongside the existing traces E2E specs.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The changed *spec.ts files (ServiceGraphNodeSidePanel.spec.ts, TraceDetailsSidebar.spec.ts) are Vitest unit tests under web/src/ — these do not count as Playwright E2E coverage.
